summary: A 1948 82-ft L-6 timber lookout in Hells Canyon, replacing a 1916 pole tower; closed for safety since August 2024, no reopening found.

corrections.why: The register and firelookout.com both describe an 82-foot treated timber tower (about 25 m). 2.1 looks like a unit or entry error. Oregon Hikers gives 80 ft. The height to the cab floor is not stated.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1916 60-ft pole tower was replaced in 1948 by the present 82-ft tower. The record's 1948 matches the current structure.

Oregon Hikers' page (last modified 27 July 2025) says visitors may climb the observation deck, but its text may predate the closure. The Forest Service closure notice of August 20, 2024 closed public use of both decks and is the official word.

sources.title: Temporary Closure of Hat Point Lookout in Hells Canyon

notes_for_editor: Current access is the main open question: the Forest Service closure of Aug 2024 is about two years old, the closure length was undetermined, and no reopening notice was found. Verify with the Wallowa Mountains front desk 541-426-5546. The Battle Creek Fire caption has no year and the name is unconfirmed; a Hells Canyon Scenic Byway post (1989 fire) returned HTTP 404 twice and was not used. Elevation differs: register 6,960 ft (record 2121.4 m matches), firelookout.com 6,982 ft. Oregon Hikers says 80 ft and climbing allowed; its page footer says last modified 27 July 2025, after the Aug 2024 closure. That is an edit date, so the guide's climbing text may still predate the closure. A WTA search snippet (not read) says climbing access ended years ago. Staffing as_of 2005 rests on one visit report and an undated firelookout.com line; the 2024 closure also stopped administrative use of the cab, so current staffing is doubtful.
